summary: Naver External Directions Link A (FRONTEND-ONLY, pure deterministic URL building — no Naver API call, key, fetch, scrape, or storage; no backend/shared/DB/migration/gateway/config change). New isolated web/src/naver-map-links.ts: naverCoordToken(coord) = base62(round((coord+200)*1e7)) over the 0-9a-zA-Z alphabet (verified against the plan's observed samples: 127.0248712→3zjD4Y, 37.5045700→2AJrSI, 127.0339086→3zk0AC, 37.5073233→2AJz2N), returning null for non-finite/|coord|>180 so render paths never throw; naverSearchUrl(query) → https://map.naver.com/p/search/<encodeURIComponent>; naverTransitDirectionsUrl(origin,dest) → https://map.naver.com/p/directions/{lonTok,latTok,encLabel,,}/{…}/-/transit?c=15.00,0,0,0,dh from two {lat,lng,label?} endpoints (lon token first; empty placeholder Naver place id/type fields, isolated for a later cycle), returning null if any coordinate token is invalid. The /p/directions route shape is reverse-engineered from Naver's web app and commented as best-effort, NOT an official/stable contract. Today.tsx: the single-location map/search links (event-detail mapSearchHref + Today chip mapHrefForContext) now build Naver search URLs keyed by the resolved display label (∥ authored text) instead of Google; FeasibilityPanel passes surface.locationContexts to TransitionCostsSection, and each shown transition row renders ONE compact external transition-directions link ("길찾기", target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer, 44px) ONLY when BOTH adjacent endpoints have status:resolved locationContexts with non-null coordinates AND naverTransitDirectionsUrl returns non-null — otherwise nothing (fail soft, no UI error). Additive next to TransitionTravelLine; does not change travel.durationMinutes or any feasibility semantics; aria-label attributes the route timing to Naver. styles.css .feas-transition-directions (semantic tokens, 44px). Tests: 6 helper unit tests (4 sample tokens locked, search encoding safety, invalid→null, full directions URL shape, missing-label fallback); 5 existing cycle-74/75 link tests updated to Naver; +3 new transition-directions tests (both-resolved renders the link; unresolved/coordinate-less omits; no-contexts omits without error). Existing cycle-76 travel evidence and transition/event-detail/card tests still pass. Docs: naver-directions-roadmap (cycle 77 implemented; 78-79 candidates), map-roadmap marked complete, codebase-map updated. Committed 15e1713.
